correctness.rationale: For the abstract two-color four-letter language, the triple update excludes precisely a new adjacent equal pair or a new period-two square. The independent orbit-graph calculation confirmed all ten weighted states, the determinant D and the numerator N through degree 12; the adjugate bound deg_z(D F)≤12 makes this an all-coefficient certificate. Independent finite enumeration also matched lengths 0 through 8, including 48, 320 and 2192 at the first three even lengths cited. The full 36-state graph is connected, and closed walks based at the same triple have (length,weight)=(3,1),(4,1). Length gcd 1 gives primitivity, and the unimodularity of these two vectors excludes any nonzero lattice phase on the unit circle away from 0, giving span one. The dominant pole is simple, also in D at u=1, and continues analytically; the amplitude at u=1 is √3 at r=(√3−1)/2. For a separate differentiation check set G(x,t)=D(x exp(−t/2),exp(t)); it is even in t and G_tt(x,0)=x³(2x⁴+4x³−x²−8x−2). At x=r, G_tt/(r G_x)=(7√3−6)/72>0, the second derivative of minus the log pole, while symmetry gives exact mean n/2. The finite-state local limit hence yields amplitude √3/(√(2πσ²)), the stated balanced prefactor, only at eligible even n; quasi-powers yields the CLT. These limit conclusions use the analytic argument, not extrapolation from the finite counts. The supplied script was inspected, not run.
